abstract.description: This document contains 100k events, where two muon candidates were observed. The data was selected from the primary dataset DoubleMu 2011. These data were selected for use in education and outreach and contain a subset of the total event information. They are not suitable for a full physics analysis.

dataset_semantics.description: The run number of the event.
Either T or G: whether the muon is a tracker or global muon.
The total energy of the muon (GeV).
The components of the momemtum of the muon (GeV).
The transverse momentum of the muon (GeV).
The phi angle of the muon (rad).
The invariant mass of two muons (GeV).

methodology.description: An event was selected if there were two muons in the event, both with |eta| < 2.4, at least one muon was a global muon, the invariant mass of the two muons was > 0.3 GeV and < 300 GeV, and they have opposite-sign charge.
